categories.name: A. Getting to the seat map

cases.title: You can only pick seats on step 2

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Two steps only: 01 Passenger Info, 02 Ancillaries. No Select Seat before step 2. Aircraft on the flight details: 738. (Seat-only adjustment: fare-package wording ignored.)

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: N/A: airline flow is Passengers > Extras > Seats > Review; no equivalent wizard

evidence.body: Observed values in text; no screenshot (the page moved on before one was taken)

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Log in to Admin and go to Booking-Mid Office.
2. Pick the branch, agency and agent, search for a flight and press 'Book Flight'.
3. Look at the step names at the top before filling anything in.
detail.expected:
There are only TWO steps: '01 Passenger Info and Bundles' and '02 Ancillaries'. There is no third step.
While step 2 has not been reached, there is no 'Select Seat' button to press.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Seats can only be chosen after passenger details and a fare package are filled in.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: The wizard used to have 3 steps. It changed to 2 steps on 15 Sep 2026.

cases.title: You cannot reach the seats without choosing a fare package

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. On step 1, fill in every box for every passenger.
2. Do NOT choose a fare package.
3. Press 'Next'.
detail.expected:
You are not allowed to move on. The message 'Bundle selection is required' appears.
Step 2 is still not reached, so the seat map cannot be opened.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: A fare package must be chosen first, because it decides which seats you are allowed to take.

cases.title: Missing passenger details and a missing fare package are both reported

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. On an empty step 1 (nothing filled in, no fare package), press 'Next'.
2. Now fill in every passenger box, still with no fare package, and press 'Next' again.
detail.expected:
First time: 'Required' appears under each empty passenger box.
Second time: only 'Bundle selection is required' appears.
Neither message hides the other, and step 2 is not reached either time.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: One kind of error must not hide the other.

cases.title: 'Select Seat' opens the seat map

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Map opens full width (1920 of 1920 px), titled "Seat Map · CAI → MCT · Onward"; left panel, seat chart, colour key and bottom buttons present.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: Comparable: airline Seats step shows "CAI - MCT", Boeing 737, Economy cabin

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Reach step 2 with a fare package chosen.
2. Press 'Select Seat' for one passenger and one flight.
detail.expected:
The seat map opens full screen. Its title reads 'Seat Map - CAI -> JED - Onward' (the airports and direction of the flight you picked).
You can see: the left panel, the seat chart, the colour key and the button at the bottom.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: The map that opens belongs to the flight whose button you pressed.

cases.title: You can skip seats completely

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: Seat-only adjustment
rows.value: "Booking can still be finished" not checked

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Nothing chosen: bottom button "Continue without seats"; pressing it closes the map, no seat given, amount stays EGP 24,658.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: N/A: no seat action performed on the airline site (read-only reference)

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Open the seat map and choose nothing.
2. Look at the button at the bottom.
3. Press 'Continue without seats'.
detail.expected:
With no seat chosen the bottom button reads 'Continue without seats'.
Pressing it closes the map, gives nobody a seat, leaves the price unchanged, and the booking can still be finished.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Seats are optional - the booking must still work with no seat chosen.

cases.title: A supplier with no seat selection shows no seat option

2. Look for seat options.
detail.expected: No 'Select Seat' button, no seat map, and no seat line in the price.

categories.name: B. How the map is drawn

cases.title: The seat total matches the seats you can see

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: Match: airline seat map has 150 seats (rows 10-35, no row 13, 3-3)

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Open the seat map.
2. Read the seat total in the left panel (shown as 'SEATS 174', for example).
3. Count the seats actually drawn.
detail.expected:
The two numbers are the same.
Check that they match - do NOT expect a particular number, because every aircraft is different.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: If the map draws fewer seats than it claims, seats that could be sold are hidden.

cases.title: Every seat has one clear state and one seat number

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: 150 unique seat numbers, row labels all match; states: 132 available paid + 13 Blocked + 5 Occupied = 150.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: Comparable: airline 120 available + 30 not available. The 18 Blocked/Occupied seats are not available on both; the other 12 are the exit rows (Comparison C1)

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Sort every seat into one group: free / costs money / taken / not offered to this passenger / women-only / held by someone else in your booking.
2. List every row and seat drawn.
3. Check each seat's label against the row it sits in.
detail.expected:
Every seat belongs to exactly one group, and the groups added together equal the seat total in the left panel.
No seat number appears twice, and no seat is missing a state.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: A seat with no state, or two seats with the same number, would break the booking.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: The list of states changed on 15 Sep 2026.

cases.title: Every seat has a full description

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Every description has seat, row, side, section (Y1), features, and ends with "Blocked", "Occupied" or "available for EGP n"; printed seat matches. Note: "Occupied" is a third ending not named in the sheet; it is in the colour key.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: N/A: airline site has no per-seat text description

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Read the description of every seat.
detail.expected:
Each description is filled in and contains: seat number, row number, which block it is in, which section, any special features, and at the end either 'Blocked' or 'available for <price>'.
The seat number in the description matches the number printed on the seat.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: The description is the only reliable place to read a seat's price and state.

cases.title: Cabin and section information agrees with the map

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Colour key: one cabin, Economy; all 150 seats in section Y1 Economy; one deck (Main deck).

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Compare the cabins named in the colour key with the cabins the seats actually belong to.
2. Compare each seat's section name with the section it is drawn under.
3. If the aircraft has an upper level as well as a lower one, check both are drawn.
detail.expected:
Every cabin named in the colour key exists on the map, and every cabin on the map is named in the colour key. The section names agree too.
On an aircraft with two cabins, both must be shown - not only Economy. On a two-level aircraft, both levels must be shown.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: A whole cabin must not go missing from the map.

cases.title: The flight shown on the map is the flight you chose

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Route CAI → MCT, flight WY408 and times 01:15 → 06:55 on 10 Nov 2026 match the chosen flight, but the aircraft type does not: flight details say "Aircraft: 738", the seat map says "WY408 · 73M".

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Write down the route, flight number, aircraft type and times from the flight you selected.
2. Compare them with the flight details in the left panel of the seat map.
detail.expected: All the details match, including the aircraft type.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: This proves the map is not an old or leftover one from a previous search.

cases.title: Two different flights give two different maps

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 11 Second flight on a different aircraft

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Two aircraft types from the Group 10 search: WY408 (73M, 150 seats, rows 10-35) and WY603 (739, 171 seats). The two maps differ and each matches its own aircraft. (Second flight taken from the multi-city search, kept separate from the primary comparison.)

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: Match: airline WY 408 150 seats, WY 603 171 seats

detail.preconditions: See the 'Before every test' sheet. You also need a second flight using a DIFFERENT aircraft type.
detail.testData: 11 Second flight on a different aircraft
steps: 1. Go through to the seat map for flight A and write down the aircraft, seat total, rows and layout.
2. Do the same for flight B, which uses a different aircraft type.
detail.expected:
The two maps are different, and each one matches its own aircraft.
Neither map is a copy of the other.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Catches a map that is fixed in the code or reused from an earlier flight - the worst possible fault here.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: You need a second flight on a different aircraft type; which aircraft flies a route is decided by the airline, so this cannot always be arranged.

cases.title: Each flight in a trip gets its own map

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Group 09 return trip: two maps, "CAI → MCT · Onward" (WY408 · 73M, 150 seats) and "MCT → CAI · Return" (WY407 · 73M, 150 seats), each with its own flight.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: Match: the airline returns two maps, WY 408 (150) and WY 407 (150)

detail.testData: 09 Return trip - default passengers, Economy
steps: 1. Search a return trip (or a multi-city trip).
2. Reach step 2.
3. Open the seat map for each flight.
detail.expected:
There is a separate map for each flight, each titled with its own route and direction (Onward, Return).
Each map matches its own aircraft.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: On a return trip the second flight may be a different aircraft with a different layout.

cases.title: A taken seat can be looked at but not booked

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Occupied seat 10D: box says "Seat 10D is occupied", button "Seat unavailable" greyed out, no error, count stays 0/2.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: N/A: not clicked on the airline site

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Click any seat shown as taken.
2. Look at the box that opens and at its button.
detail.expected:
The box opens and says 'Blocked' and 'Seat 13A is blocked.'
The button is there but greyed out and now reads 'Seat unavailable'.
No error message pops up, the seats-chosen count does not change, and any seat you already chose stays chosen.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: The system refuses by greying out the button, not by showing an error.

cases.title: Seat features use known wording

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Words outside the sheet's known list appear: Left/Right side of aircraft, Bulkhead seat, Seat with bassinet facility, Seat to be left vacant or offered last, Center seat (not window, not aisle), Front of cabin class/compartment, Overwing seat(s), Seat not allowed for infant, Seat not allowed for medical. "Bulkhead seat" is repeated twice in every row-10 description. Same result as ancillaries-run-005: the known list looks out of date, so a business decision is needed first.

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Collect the feature words shown on all seats.
2. Compare them with the known list.
3. Open a seat that has more than one feature.
detail.expected:
Every feature word is one of these: Window seat, Aisle seat, Leg space seat, Chargeable seat, Exit and emergency exit, Female designated seat.
Check that nothing unknown appears. Do NOT expect a particular feature to be present - each flight sends its own.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: If the airline sends a new kind of feature, we must notice it instead of ignoring it.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: 'Chargeable seat' was missing from the 15 Sep map but present again on 17 Sep - it depends on the flight, so its absence is not a fault.

cases.title: Window and aisle labels match where the seat really is

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: All 50 window seats are A/F, 50 aisle seats C/D, 50 centre seats B/E (3-3); no seat has two labels.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: Match: airline WINDOW/AISLE/CENTER flags agree on all 150 seats

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. For every seat marked 'Window seat', check it really is at the edge of its row.
2. For every seat marked 'Aisle seat', check it really is next to the walkway.
3. Check middle seats carry neither label.
detail.expected:
The labels match the real position, whatever the layout is (2-2, 3-3, 3-4-3 and so on).
Do NOT assume seats A and F are always windows - that is only true on this one aircraft.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: A wrongly labelled seat means a passenger is sold something different from what they picked.

cases.title: Emergency exit seats are marked

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: 12 seats marked "Exit and emergency exit", rows 18-19, all six seats of each row, next to each other; also "Seat not allowed for infant". Not marked "Leg space seat" (the sheet says "usually").

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: DIFFERENT: the airline shows the same 12 exit seats as NOT available for this party; NDC offers all 12 (Comparison C1)

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Find the seats marked 'Exit and emergency exit'.
2. Check they sit next to each other and what else they are marked with.
detail.expected:
Exit seats are next to each other in their row and usually also marked 'Leg space seat'.
Whether they are free to book depends on the airline - do not expect them always to be available.
Two kinds of passenger may never sit there: an adult who has an infant with them, and a child. (Tested in detail in group P.)

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Every exit-seat rule depends on being able to find these seats first.

cases.title: Women-only seats are marked clearly

rows.label: Reason
rows.value: Not supported by supplier: no women-only seat rule for Oman Air

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Find the seats marked as women-only.
2. Check their labels, their markings and the colour key.
detail.expected:
Being a women-only seat does NOT by itself mean the seat is unavailable.
For a male passenger it shows as unavailable and reads 'Female designated seat, not offered for <first name>'.
For a female passenger the same seat becomes available and reads 'available for <price>'.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: These seats must be explained, not just silently blocked.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: Only works on a flight that actually has women-only seats - skip cleanly when it does not.

cases.title: One click only shows the seat - it does not book it

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: One click on 25A opens its box; count still 0/2, passenger cards show no seat, bottom button still "Continue without seats".

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: N/A: no seat action on the airline site

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Open the seat map (the count reads 0 of N).
2. Click one free seat.
3. Do nothing else.
detail.expected:
An information box opens for that seat.
The count still reads 0 of N, the passenger card still shows no seat, and the bottom button still reads 'Continue without seats'.
Nothing has been booked.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Stops a seat being booked by accident with a single click.

cases.title: A seat is only taken when you press the button in the box

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Button reads "Book 25A for Seatmap" (the passenger's first name). After pressing: count 1/2, card "25A Economy EGP 662", seat "selected for Seatmap Testadult".

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Click a free seat.
2. Read the wording on the button.
3. Press it.
detail.expected:
The button reads 'Book 5A for Mohanad' - the real seat number and the passenger's real first name from step 1.
After pressing: the count goes up by one, the passenger card shows the seat, its cabin and its price, and the seat changes colour to show it is taken by you.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: The agent must always see which seat and which passenger they are confirming.

cases.title: The seat information box is correct

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Box: "Available paid, Seat 25A EGP 662 per passenger, Economy, Main deck, Window seat, Row 25 15th of 25 rows in Y1, Middle of this deck"; agrees with the seat description.

rows.label: Oman Air website
rows.value: Comparable: airline price for 25A is USD 11.9

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Click a seat.
2. Compare every line in the box with the seat's own description and with the left panel.
detail.expected:
The box shows the right state, seat number, price, cabin, where the seat sits in its row, and where the row sits in its section ('Row 5 - 5th of 7 rows in Y-1').
Everything agrees with the seat's own description.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: This box is what the agent reads before deciding.

cases.title: The bottom button changes as seats are chosen

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: "Continue without seats" -> "Confirm 1 of 2 seats" -> "Confirm 2 seats"; "Clear all seats" beside it; total 2 (infant not counted); cards ACTIVE / SELECT / SELECTED / ASSIGNED.

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Note the bottom button with nothing chosen.
2. Choose a seat.
3. Read the button again.
detail.expected:
The button changes in this order: 'Continue without seats' -> 'Confirm 1 of 2 seats' -> 'Confirm 2 seats'.
A 'Clear all seats' button sits next to it.
The total counts only passengers who can have a seat - infants are not counted.
Passenger cards show ACTIVE / SELECT / SELECTED / ASSIGNED.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: It is how the agent knows whether anything is currently held.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: The old wording 'Confirm seat' no longer exists.

cases.title: Moving a passenger to another seat frees the first seat

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Adult moved 25A -> 26A: adult holds only 26A, 25A back to "available for EGP 662", count 2/2.

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Give a passenger seat X.
2. Click seat Y and book it for the same passenger.
detail.expected:
The passenger has only seat Y.
Seat X goes back to free, and the count still shows one seat for that passenger, not two.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Otherwise one passenger holds two seats and a seat is lost from sale.

cases.title: 'Clear all seats' also removes the seat charge

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Clear all seats: count 1/2 -> 0/2, 26A free again, button back to "Continue without seats"; after closing, the Seat Selection line is gone and the amount is back to EGP 24,658.

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Choose a seat.
2. Press 'Clear all seats'.
detail.expected: All seats are given up, the count goes back to 0 of N, the seats become free again, the bottom button goes back to 'Continue without seats', and any seat charge disappears from the price breakdown.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Money must not stay on the booking for a seat nobody has.

cases.title: Confirming saves the seat and closes the map

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Confirm closes the map; step 2 shows "Selected seats 2 travellers": 26A EGP 662, 27B EGP 565; opener now "Change Seats"; breakdown line "Seat Selection + 1,227". No network call was made on Confirm.

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Choose a seat.
2. Press the bottom button ('Confirm 1 seat').
3. Read the 'Selected seats' list on step 2.
detail.expected:
The map closes and step 2 shows 'Selected seats - 1 traveller' with a line per passenger (name / seat / price) and the right prices.
The button that opened the map now reads 'Change Seats'.
If the seat cost money, a 'Seat Selection' line is added to the price breakdown.
The seat number in the list is exactly the seat you clicked.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: This is the record the agent and the airline both rely on.

cases.title: 'Change Seats' reopens the map with your choice still there

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Change Seats reopens the map with 26A and 27B still held, count 2/2.

detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Confirm a seat.
2. Press 'Change Seats'.
detail.expected: The map opens again, the seat is still chosen, the count still shows it, and the passenger card still shows it.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Looking at your choice again must not lose it.

cases.title: A seat held by another passenger in your booking is marked

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: With the child active, 25A shows "selected for Seatmap Testadult" (full name) and offers no Book button.

detail.preconditions: See the 'Before every test' sheet. You need at least 2 passengers who can have a seat.
detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Give seat X to passenger A.
2. Switch to passenger B and click seat X.
detail.expected:
Seat X is shown as held and names who has it: 'selected for <A's full name>'.
Passenger B cannot take it.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Two passengers must never hold the same seat.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: The business said this seat shows simply as 'Blocked'. What we actually saw names the holder, which is better - check which is intended.

categories.name: E. More than one passenger or flight

cases.title: The seat goes to the passenger who is selected

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Adult card selected -> 25A to the adult; child card -> 25B to the child; adult keeps 25A; count "2 / 2 All assigned".

detail.preconditions: See the 'Before every test' sheet. You need at least 2 passengers.
detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. With several passengers, note which card is selected and book a seat.
2. Click a different passenger's card.
3. Book a second seat.
detail.expected:
The first seat goes to the passenger who was selected, and the button named that passenger. The others still have no seat.
After switching, the second seat goes to the newly selected passenger, the first passenger keeps theirs, and the count reads 2 of N.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: Stops a seat being given to the wrong passenger.

cases.title: Two passengers cannot have the same seat

rows.label: Setup
rows.value: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: The child cannot take the adult's 25A: shown "selected for Seatmap Testadult", no Book button.

detail.preconditions: See the 'Before every test' sheet. You need at least 2 passengers.
detail.testData: 01 Default - 1 adult + 1 child + 1 infant, one-way, Economy
steps: 1. Give seat X to passenger 1.
2. Select passenger 2 and try to book seat X.
detail.expected:
Passenger 2 cannot take seat X. It is shown as held, and it names who has it: 'selected for <full name>'.
One seat must never be held by two passengers.

extra.heading: What we are checking
extra.value: The airline would reject a booking with one seat given to two people.

extra.heading: Checklist notes
extra.value: The business answered 'Blocked' on 17 Sep, but what we saw on 15 Sep also names the holder. Treat the named version as correct and report a plain 'Blocked' with no name.

cases.title: Seats on one flight do not affect the other flight

rows.label: NDC Admin
rows.value: Return map started empty; choosing 26A on the return did not disturb the outbound 26A/26B; the summary lists each journey separately (2 travellers outbound, 1 traveller return, "Seat 1 more").

detail.preconditions: See the 'Before every test' sheet. You need a return trip.

sections.title: Headline
blocks: NDC Admin and NDC Portal gave identical results on all 49 executed cases. The seat maps match Oman Air's own site seat for seat (layout, availability, window/aisle/exit marking, price levels) on every flight compared — except one thing that matters: exit-row rules.

value.html: Oman Air applies the exit-row rule on its seat map per party; NDC never does. An adult with an infant and a child can choose and keep an exit seat in NDC. Four exit-seat cases fail (EXR-002, 003, 004, 005); this is the same fault ancillaries-run-005 already ticketed.
